approved.en: Melania Trump hosted Russian and Ukrainian officials at the White House, urging a lasting truce while fighting continued on multiple fronts. Russian drones struck an Ozon warehouse in southern Russia and a Ukrainian aid centre, raising the death toll at the aid point to 53, according to Reuters. Ukraine responded with drone attacks on the Ryazan refinery and on sites in Dnipropetrovsk and Kyiv oblasts, injuring four people. Germany announced an additional €100 million for Ukrainian infrastructure and Italy prepared fresh military aid despite coalition splits. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Melania Trump mottok russiske og ukrainske tjenestemenn i Det hvite hus, og oppfordret til en varig våpenhvile mens kampene fortsatte på flere fronter. Russiske droner rammet et Ozon-lager i sørlige Russland og et ukrainsk hjelpesenter, og dødstallet ved hjelpepunket steg til 53, ifølge Reuters. Ukraina svarte med droneangrep på Ryazan-raffineriet og på mål i Dnipropetrovsk og Kyiv-oblaster, og fire personer ble skadet. Tyskland kunngjorde ytterligere €100 millioner til ukrainsk infrastruktur, og Italia forberedte ny militærhjelp til tross for splittelser i koalisjonen. Dødsfall knyttet til kamper beløp seg til 75 767 i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli President announced on Sunday the person who will attempt to form the next government, while opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot reported progress in coalition talks and faced opposition easing on the ultra-Orthodox draft. Israeli settlers seized eight Palestinian homes in Jericho, displacing dozens, and IDF arrested three Palestinians planning terror attacks in the West Bank. In Gaza, gunfire damaged tents at the Rafah displacement site as aid teams prepared for winter storms, and residents built wind turbines from rubble and turned discarded cooking pots into seawalls. 21,440 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israelske bosettere tok over åtte palestinske hjem i Jeriko, og fordrev dusinvis, og IDF arresterte tre palestinere som planla terrorangrep på Vestbredden. I Gaza ble telt på Rafah-flyktningleiren skadet av skudd, mens hjelpearbeidere forberedte seg på vinterstormer, og innbyggere bygde vindturbiner av ruiner og gjorde om kastede gryter til sjøvoller. 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israel is conducting air, drone and ground operations in southern Lebanon, striking targets and carrying out detonations that have killed civilians and injured others, while Hezbollah fires artillery at Israeli positions and has begun cash payments to war victims and displaced families. The United Nations reports 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon by the fighting. Israel has also built a new road in the Shebaa Valley buffer zone, a development not mentioned previously. The conflict, which began in October 2023, continues to generate civilian hardship and displacement. 4,335 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

FN rapporterer at 300 000 personer er fordrevet i Libanon på grunn av kampene. Israel har også bygget en ny vei i bufferområdet Shebaa-dalen, en utvikling som ikke ble nevnt tidligere. Konflikten, som startet i oktober 2023, fortsetter å påføre sivile vanskeligheter og fordrivelse. 4 335 dødsfall knyttet til kamper fant sted i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Iran has launched a missile that struck a building in Tel Aviv and threatened to reopen the Strait of Hormuz if U.S. conditions are met, while the United States has struck Iran's Qeshm Island. Iran sent a secret Khamenei message to Putin as Moscow pushes a gas pipeline deal and a rocket launcher deal illustrates deepening Russia-Iran relations. South Korea is extending anti-piracy patrols closer to the Strait of Hormuz, and Iran reports tankers hit in the strait and a Saudi coalition intercepting a missile aimed at Medina. Iran has sent a nuclear proposal to the United States via Qatar and is reviewing concrete proposals on its nuclear program. 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Iran sendte en hemmelig Khamenei-melding til Putin mens Moskva presser på en gassrørledningsavtale og en rakettkasteravtale viser dypere Russland-Iran-relasjoner. Sør-Korea forlenker anti-piratpatruljer nærmere Hormuzstredet, og Iran melder om tankskip som ble truffet i stredet og en saudisk koalisjon som avskjærte et missil rettet mot Medina. Iran har sendt et atomforslag til USA via Qatar og gjennomgår konkrete forslag til sitt atomprogram. 123 battle-related deaths i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Houthi forces continue a month-long siege of Taiz while Yemeni government troops have seized the strategic al-Jawf mountain range, intensifying front-line fighting. The coalition reports downing a Houthi ballistic missile aimed at Medina and intercepting another long-range anti-tank guided missile that struck a Saudi-backed vehicle, wounding a fighter. A market strike in southwestern Yemen killed at least 20 civilians, and a missile attack on an oil tanker in the Gulf killed a sailor. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Koalisjonen melder om å ha skutt ned et houthi-ballistisk missil rettet mot Medina og avverget et annet langdistanse-antitank-styrt missil som traff et Saudi-støttet kjøretøy, og såret en kriger. Et markedangrep i sør-vestlige Jemen drepte minst 20 sivile, og et missilangrep på en oljetanker i Gulf drepte en sjømann. Konflikten forårsaket 918 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Sudan’s war has spread to its power grid, with attacks disrupting electricity supply across the country. The UN peacekeeping chief warned that RSF drone strikes launched from Ethiopian territory pose a new threat to civilians, prompting Ethiopia to expel six Sudanese consular staff and close Sudan’s consulate, while Sudan shut the Ethiopian consulate in retaliation. Factories are struggling to restart after wartime damage. The conflict caused 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: City councils in South Sudan are now handling over 600 tonnes of waste daily, most from Thongpiny, while a nurse was shot and wounded in Cueibet in a suspected revenge attack. Riek Machar has said he took steps to prevent further violence in Nasir and Ulang and traced years of bloodshed there, even as disputes over fishing nets were cited as triggers of recent clashes in Nasir. A Kenyan preacher who urged followers to starve to death was sentenced to 200 years in prison, and a UN clash with Sudan over Abyei’s inclusion in December elections has drawn Security Council attention to the region. Coffee gatherings are being used to rebuild trust in communities, and women in Tambura are crossing ethnic divides to promote peace, while a border clinic faces closure risk for 100,000 people. The UCDP recorded 2 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Byrådene i Sør-Sudan håndterer nå over 600 tonn avfall daglig, mest fra Thongpiny, mens en sykepleier ble skutt og såret i Cueibet i et antatt hevnangrep. Riek Machar har sagt at han har tatt skritt for å hindre ytterligere vold i Nasir og Ulang og har sporet år med blodbad der, selv om tvister om fiskegarn ble nevnt som utløsere for nylige sammenstøt i Nasir. En kenyansk predikant som oppfordret til at følgerne skulle sulte i hjel, ble dømt til 200 år i fengsel, og en FN-konflikt med Sudan om Abyei sin medvirkning i desember-valgene har fått Sikkerhetsrådet til å rette oppmerksomheten mot regionen. Kaffesamlinger brukes til å gjenoppbygge tillit i lokalsamfunn, og kvinner i Tambura krysser etniske skiller for å fremme fred, mens en grenseklinikk risikerer å bli stengt og rammer 100 000 personer. UCDP registrerte to dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

The United States is negotiating a long-term military presence in Venezuela and Trump has floated a one-day operation to capture Maduro, while a U.S. soldier faces court after being arrested for betting on Maduro's removal. Oliver Blanco met a U.S. official in Washington as the negotiations continue. The UCDP counted 2 battle-related deaths in 2007, according to UCDP.
